data.question: Regarding the International Criminal Court (ICC), which statement correctly identifies its foundational principle?
options: It only intervenes when local legal systems fail or refuse to act
It possesses an independent military wing for arrests
It automatically replaces domestic courts in all cases
It has retroactive jurisdiction over every sovereign state
data.correct_answer: It only intervenes when local legal systems fail or refuse to act

data.question: Which of these nations is NOT among those that have recently announced their departure from the ICC?
options: Venezuela
Chad
Norway
Niger
data.correct_answer: Norway

data.question: Why does the ICC investigation into the Philippines still hold legal weight even after its withdrawal in 2019?
options: The ICC ignores all state withdrawals
The UN Security Council revoked their exit
The Rome Statute dictates that withdrawal isn't retroactive
Philippines never officially filed for withdrawal
data.correct_answer: The Rome Statute dictates that withdrawal isn't retroactive

data.question: In the context of the BRICS grouping, how does India prefer the bloc to be viewed by the global community?
options: As a rival trade bloc replacing the WTO
As a vehicle for direct confrontation with the Quad
As an explicitly anti-Western military alliance
As a platform for reforming global governance
data.correct_answer: As a platform for reforming global governance

data.question: Which of the following describes Brazil's diplomatic stance within the BRICS framework?
options: It prioritizes total de-dollarisation as its primary goal
It seeks to overthrow Western-led institutions from the outside
It pushes for reforms while maintaining strong links to Euro-Atlantic traditions
It views Iran as its main strategic role model
data.correct_answer: It pushes for reforms while maintaining strong links to Euro-Atlantic traditions

data.question: What is the primary driver behind U.S. President Trump's aggressive rhetoric toward the Federal Reserve?
options: Desire for lower borrowing costs amid massive national debt
Objection to the Fed's strict environmental policies
Concerns regarding the global surplus of US Treasury bonds
A plan to switch the US currency to digital gold
data.correct_answer: Desire for lower borrowing costs amid massive national debt

data.question: Why has the potential India-US Interim Trade Agreement caused unrest among Indian farmers?
options: The agreement removes the state's power to purchase wheat
It could allow lower tariffs on US farm imports like apples and cotton
The deal forces them to export all rice stocks
Farmers are required to switch entirely to US seed brands
data.correct_answer: It could allow lower tariffs on US farm imports like apples and cotton

data.question: How has India adjusted its energy sourcing strategy following the West Asia crisis?
options: Banned the import of crude oil from Russia
Shifted over half of its LPG imports to US suppliers
Stopped all energy trading with Gulf nations
Increased reliance on local wind power solely
data.correct_answer: Shifted over half of its LPG imports to US suppliers

data.question: Which landmark historical event marks the most recent phase of border tension between India and China?
options: The 2017 peaceful border settlement
The 2020 Eastern Ladakh standoff
The 1962 Sikkim standoff
The 1984 Siachen glacier conflict
data.correct_answer: The 2020 Eastern Ladakh standoff

data.question: What specific ecological role does the Przewalski's horse play in its natural steppe environment?
options: It functions as an apex predator
It increases wildfire risks by encouraging tree growth
It serves as a primary source of nitrogen for local crops
It grazes on dry vegetation, helping to lower fire risks
data.correct_answer: It grazes on dry vegetation, helping to lower fire risks

data.question: The S-71K Kovyor missile, recently unveiled by Russia, is primarily designed for which aircraft?
options: MiG-29 upgraded variant
Tu-160 bomber
Su-27 legacy interceptor
Su-57E fifth-generation fighter
data.correct_answer: Su-57E fifth-generation fighter

data.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the three thematic books within the Thirukkural?
options: Book of War (Por)
Book of Love (Inbam)
Book of Polity (Porul)
Book of Virtue (Aram)
data.correct_answer: Book of War (Por)

data.question: What core characteristic defines the Thirukkural's approach to the concept of God?
options: Divine favor requires strict adherence to one specific caste
God is synonymous with pure intelligence and compassion
He is an angry judge of sinners
There is no mention of God in the text
data.correct_answer: God is synonymous with pure intelligence and compassion

data.question: Which nation provides the best illustration of a country that maintains strategic autonomy while staying firmly connected to the Western-led legal and constitutional order?
options: Iran
Russia
Brazil
China
data.correct_answer: Brazil

data.question: The term 'Shadow Transhipment Network' is frequently used by Washington to describe which country's trade impact?
options: China
India
Mexico
Canada
data.correct_answer: China

data.question: How did the 2023 expansion of BRICS affect the internal dynamics of the bloc regarding anti-Western sentiment?
options: It solidified the bloc as a perfectly unified anti-Western unit
It expelled countries with pro-Western ties
It made military alignment with Russia mandatory
It increased internal diversity, making a single unified stance on the West harder
data.correct_answer: It increased internal diversity, making a single unified stance on the West harder

data.question: Why did India and the US recently initiate tougher documentation requirements for textile exporters?
options: To combat forced labour and verify supply chain transparency
To increase the weight of every cotton bale shipped
To prevent the leakage of patented clothing designs
To standardize the color codes of exported fabrics
data.correct_answer: To combat forced labour and verify supply chain transparency

data.question: Which phrase best characterizes the 'S-71K Kovyor' missile's flight profile?
options: It must be guided manually by the pilot until impact
It is only effective against moving naval targets
It follows a powered-cruise profile, allowing target approach from various axes
It behaves like a simple, slow-falling gravity bomb
data.correct_answer: It follows a powered-cruise profile, allowing target approach from various axes

data.question: What was the initial context in which the term 'BRIC' was coined?
options: A European trade organization created for agriculture
A military alliance pact signed in 1945
A UN resolution on human rights in Asia
A Goldman Sachs report on emerging economic powerhouses
data.correct_answer: A Goldman Sachs report on emerging economic powerhouses

data.question: What is the primary significance of the S-71K's ability to fly at very low altitudes over water?
options: It increases its internal fuel storage capacity
It masks the missile from continuous long-range radar tracking
It enables the pilot to communicate with the missile using sonar
It allows the missile to be launched from a submarine
data.correct_answer: It masks the missile from continuous long-range radar tracking
